verdict: Changes requested: malformed metadata shapes can abort collection; whitespace-only contexts can be confirmed

read_record.method: Complete static inspection; isolated execution with explicit synthetic session roots only.

positive_findings: Recursive discovery across date directories finds matching parent children; unrelated parents excluded.

All parsed model/effort contexts and source line numbers are retained, including later settings different from earlier context. confirmed means observed nonempty setting fields, not agreement with an expected model.
Exact captured byte lengths and hashes bind settings to snapshot files.
Missing contexts, missing/numeric/empty field cases and malformed JSON lines are not confirmed; malformed JSON is disclosed.
Duplicate actors/session IDs are surfaced for valid textual identifiers.
New output uses exclusive creation; existing content preserved; relative/absolute/symlink escapes rejected before collection.

findings.finding: Valid JSON with unexpected object/container shapes raises AttributeError or TypeError and aborts collect, instead of disclosing discovery/parse issues and continuing other records.
findings.locations: collect: initial.get; meta.get; source subagent/thread_spawn chains; event.get; turn_context payload.get; Counter(record agent/session_id).
findings.recommendation: Type-check decoded first/events/payloads/nested provenance containers and actor/session identifiers before .get/hash operations. Record structured discovery/record parse issues for malformed cases; keep affected records unconfirmed or undiscovered as appropriate and continue unaffected files. Do not silently drop malformed relevant context.

findings.finding: Whitespace-only model and effort values pass current nonempty-string test and produce confirmed=true.
findings.recommendation: Require non-whitespace strings (value.strip()) for actual model/effort metadata. Preserve exact raw observed strings in evidence while marking invalid context unconfirmed. Do not confuse field-presence confirmation with expected-model agreement.

contract_and_limits: Metadata snapshots establish only actual observed model/effort settings at recorded contexts. They do not prove terminal status, input isolation, fork setting, attention, instruction compliance, content correctness, or gameplay grades.
Incoming encrypted prompts are not proved by metadata; no ciphertext was decrypted.

A later mismatch is retained as a later actual context. This helper has no expected-model argument; downstream consumers must explicitly compare ALL observed contexts to their requested settings and resolve duplicates/issues.
Recursive matching is for direct parent_thread_id children, not a recursive descendant ancestry proof.
Snapshots may grow after capture; terminal verification requires new complete snapshots and explicit comparison, not status inference.
This review used only this new helper and synthetic trees. No actual runtime/provenance index, real reader files or grades were read for the generic tool review.
Original tools, frozen indexes and all earlier reviews remain unchanged.
